newsitem.title: INDIA: Indian call money shut for Hindu festival.
newsitem.headline: Indian call money shut for Hindu festival.

text.p: India's call money markets were closed on Monday for a Hindu festival, dealers said.
They will reopen for trading on Tuesday..
Call rates on Friday ended unchanged from the day's opening levels, in the 9.75-10.0 percent range, after touching 10.50 percent in stray deals, dealers said.
Towards the end of the day, rates came down as some lenders, who had been off the market earlier in the day, came back, dealers said.
